description: UI-only, no domain logic. Migrate every file that imports Text/TextInput from 'react-native' (34 files) to the app-owned AppText/AppTextInput from FEAT-001, and apply layout-only clipping fixes so no Spanish copy is clipped at font factors 1.0/1.15/1.3. Depends on FEAT-001. Replace component imports only; KEEP type-only imports (TextProps/TextStyle/TextInputProps) from 'react-native'. Use ONLY existing theme tokens from src/constants/theme.ts. Do NOT shorten any Spanish copy. All paths relative to apps/mobile.
steps: For each file below: change the 'react-native' import so the Text/TextInput COMPONENTS are no longer imported from 'react-native' (keep View, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, Animated, type-only TextInputProps/TextStyle, etc.), add import { AppText, AppTextInput } from the correct relative path to components/AppText (or only AppText where TextInput isn't used), and replace JSX usages Text -> AppText and TextInput -> AppTextInput. Keep all existing props (style, numberOfLines, placeholder, value, onChangeText, etc.).

Migrate the shared component FIRST: src/components/form/FormControls.tsx (Field, TextField, SelectField, SubmitButton, RowItem). It is reused by most admin screens, so fixing its layout centrally resolves many list rows and chips. Keep the type-only import of TextInputProps from 'react-native'.

Migrate the 12 remaining Text+TextInput files: app/(tabs)/crew.tsx, app/(tabs)/payments.tsx, app/(tabs)/production.tsx, app/(tabs)/register.tsx, app/admin/fields/index.tsx, app/admin/products.tsx, app/admin/records.tsx, app/admin/settlements.tsx, app/admin/workers.tsx, app/change-password.tsx, app/login.tsx, src/components/DayRosterManager.tsx.

Migrate the 21 Text-only files: app/(tabs)/metrics.tsx, app/(tabs)/profile.tsx, app/(tabs)/team.tsx, app/admin/box-types.tsx, app/admin/crews.tsx, app/admin/fields/[id].tsx, app/admin/index.tsx, app/admin/permission-profiles.tsx, app/admin/settings.tsx, app/admin/supervisors.tsx, src/components/AnimatedNumber.tsx, src/components/AnimatedSplash.tsx, src/components/DatePicker.tsx, src/components/EmptyState.tsx, src/components/FloatingTabBar.tsx, src/components/OfflineBanner.tsx, src/components/PaymentToast.tsx, src/components/PhotoCapture.tsx, src/components/QRScanner.tsx, src/components/SuccessOverlay.tsx, src/components/admin/AdminDrawerContent.tsx.

Apply clipping fixes per the pattern already proven in app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (do NOT alter profile.tsx's existing fixes, only swap its Text->AppText): for label+value rows give the text container flex:1 or flexShrink:1 with minWidth:0 and the value textAlign where appropriate; for list item rows (RowItem and screen-local rows) ensure the title/subtitle wrapper has flex:1 and text can wrap/ellipsize; for tiny fixed-width chips/segmented controls (period chips, role pill, badges, stat-tile labels) use numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit so they shrink-to-fit rather than hard-clip; for buttons with leading/trailing icons give the label flex:1 and numberOfLines where a single line is required.

Per-component trade-off to honor: body text, field labels, values, list-row titles/subtitles MUST grow with the scale factor (NO adjustsFontSizeToFit on them). adjustsFontSizeToFit is ONLY for tiny fixed chips/tiles/pills where growing would overflow; note that such chips will not visibly grow with the scale — acceptable for those elements only.

FloatingTabBar.tsx: the 9px tab labels are in a fixed-height bar. Keep them single-line (numberOfLines=1); do NOT allow wrapping to two lines which would break the bar layout. They may shrink/ellipsize but must not wrap. Document this choice in a short code comment.

AnimatedNumber.tsx: swap Text->AppText; the numeric ticker has its own fontSize via the passed style, so it scales once. No clipping change needed unless the ticker sits in a width-constrained row (that is the parent screen's responsibility).
AnimatedSplash.tsx and OfflineBanner.tsx render outside FontScaleProvider; AppText there falls back to factor 1 (safe). Still migrate them for consistency; no behavior change expected.
Do NOT change any Spanish string literal. Do NOT introduce colors/spacing/radius/font values that are not already exported by src/constants/theme.ts.
acceptance_criteria: No file under apps/mobile/app or apps/mobile/src imports the Text or TextInput COMPONENT from 'react-native' except apps/mobile/src/components/AppText.tsx (type-only imports like TextInputProps/TextStyle may remain).
All 34 listed files render AppText/AppTextInput instead of RN Text/TextInput and preserve their original props.
No Spanish UI copy was shortened or reworded (verifiable via git diff: only import lines, JSX tag names, and style/layout props changed for copy-bearing lines).

Any style changes reference only tokens exported by src/constants/theme.ts (colors/spacing/radius/font) plus layout primitives (flex, flexShrink, minWidth, numberOfLines, adjustsFontSizeToFit, textAlign, gap, includeFontPadding).
profile.tsx retains its pre-existing clipping fixes unchanged apart from the Text->AppText swap.
verification: From apps/mobile: grep for the react-native component import of Text/TextInput across app and src .tsx files returns only type imports (TextInputProps/TextStyle); the only component Text/TextInput import is in src/components/AppText.tsx.

From apps/mobile: npx expo export:embed --eager --platform android --dev false --entry-file "$(node -e "console.log(require.resolve('expo-router/entry.js'))")" --bundle-output /tmp/fundo360-verify.bundle exits 0 and prints 'Android Bundled'. Allow a few minutes; do NOT wrap in the macOS-missing timeout command.
From apps/mobile: npm run lint reports 0 errors (pre-existing 'any' warnings OK).
Manual diff review confirms no Spanish copy shortened and only existing theme tokens used.
findings:
DONE. Migrated all 34 files from RN Text/TextInput to AppText/AppTextInput (component imports removed from 'react-native'; type-only TextInputProps/TextStyle kept via `import type`). Only src/components/AppText.tsx still imports the RN Text/TextInput components (by design).

CHANGED FILES (34):
- src/components/form/FormControls.tsx (migrated FIRST; central layout fixes: RowItem wrapper flex:1 + minWidth:0, title/subtitle numberOfLines={2}; badge AppText numberOfLines={1}+adjustsFontSizeToFit; SelectField chip numberOfLines={1}+adjustsFontSizeToFit; SubmitButton label numberOfLines={1}).
- 12 Text+TextInput files: app/(tabs)/crew.tsx, app/(tabs)/payments.tsx, app/(tabs)/production.tsx, app/(tabs)/register.tsx, app/admin/fields/index.tsx, app/admin/products.tsx, app/admin/records.tsx, app/admin/settlements.tsx, app/admin/workers.tsx, app/change-password.tsx, app/login.tsx, src/components/DayRosterManager.tsx.
- 21 Text-only files: app/(tabs)/metrics.tsx, app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (only Text->AppText swap; pre-existing clipping fixes untouched), app/(tabs)/team.tsx, app/admin/box-types.tsx, app/admin/crews.tsx, app/admin/fields/[id].tsx, app/admin/index.tsx, app/admin/permission-profiles.tsx, app/admin/settings.tsx, app/admin/supervisors.tsx, src/components/AnimatedNumber.tsx, src/components/AnimatedSplash.tsx, src/components/DatePicker.tsx, src/components/EmptyState.tsx, src/components/FloatingTabBar.tsx, src/components/OfflineBanner.tsx, src/components/PaymentToast.tsx, src/components/PhotoCapture.tsx, src/components/QRScanner.tsx, src/components/SuccessOverlay.tsx, src/components/admin/AdminDrawerContent.tsx.

PER-COMPONENT RULES HONORED: body/labels/values/list titles grow with scale (no adjustsFontSizeToFit). adjustsFontSizeToFit used ONLY on tiny fixed chips/badges (FormControls SelectField chip + RowItem badge, FloatingTabBar labels). FloatingTabBar: both center and tab labels kept single-line (numberOfLines={1}+adjustsFontSizeToFit) with a documenting comment — must not wrap to 2 lines (fixed-height bar). AnimatedNumber: Text->AppText only; numeric ticker scales once via passed style. AnimatedSplash/OfflineBanner render outside FontScaleProvider -> factor 1 (safe), migrated for consistency. No Spanish copy shortened; only existing theme tokens + layout primitives used.

VERIFICATION:
- grep gate PASS: only src/components/AppText.tsx imports RN Text/TextInput components; no stray <Text/<TextInput JSX tags remain (all AppText/AppTextInput).
- npx tsc --noEmit: SAME 6 pre-existing errors as the FEAT-001 baseline (missing packages not installed in this env: react-native-gesture-handler, expo-sharing, expo-print, @react-navigation/drawer, plus the cascaded implicit-any in app/admin/_layout.tsx:15 from the missing drawer types). ZERO new type errors from any migrated file.
- npm run lint: 0 errors, 89 pre-existing warnings (any/exhaustive-deps/unused-vars); none introduced by this migration (SuccessOverlay View/colors unused warnings confirmed pre-existing via baseline eslint).
- RELEASE bundle gate (export:embed) COULD NOT RUN in this environment: babel.config.js requires 'react-native-reanimated/plugin' but react-native-reanimated (declared ~4.1.1 in package.json) is NOT installed in node_modules, so Metro fails to parse ANY file before bundling. Confirmed this is PRE-EXISTING and environment-only by stashing all FEAT-002 changes and running the same command on the committed baseline (HEAD d0ce47f): identical 'Cannot find module react-native-reanimated/plugin' failure. Not a regression from this migration. The bundle gate must be re-run by the orchestrator in an environment with mobile deps installed.

NEEDS ON-DEVICE VERIFICATION at factors 1.0/1.15/1.3 (visual, requires a rebuilt APK — not claimed here): all migrated screens, with priority on dense/width-constrained UI where clipping was reported: FormControls-driven admin lists (RowItem title/subtitle/badge) across workers/products/fields/crews/supervisors/settlements; app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (period chips, role pill, stat-tile labels, info rows); FloatingTabBar labels (must stay single-line, may shrink); SelectField/tare chips in app/(tabs)/register.tsx; label+value detail rows in production.tsx and the payment modals in payments.tsx/crew.tsx.
